events.event: Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka resigned 'at his own request' via a letter to the MPR and said in a 6m53s video the move was personal and unrelated to his diploma, with President Prabowo accepting it 'with a heavy heart'.
events.key_numbers: Resignation 12 Nov 2026 · video 6m53s · MPR meeting ~20 minutes · offered the VP role Sept 2023 · detik most-read #1 on 13 Nov
events.why_it_matters: A sitting VP quitting is unprecedented and reshapes who is next in line to the presidency.

events.event: MPR leadership outlined how the vacant vice presidency will be filled: the President proposes two candidates and the MPR elects one in a plenary session.
events.key_numbers: Max 60 days for plenary · 2 candidates proposed · names due at least 14 days before the plenary · tie vote repeated once, then President picks · 120 DPR members from 8 factions had backed the now-moot impeachment proposal (HMP)
events.why_it_matters: Explains the 'what happens next' that most people are asking after the resignation.
events.spreading_evidence: detik headline 'Gibran resign, setelah itu apa?' in most-read list

events.event: Police identified the brigadier general in the wiretapping case, now under internal review, and a lawmaker pushed a wiretapping bill setting powers and penalties.
events.why_it_matters: Shows whether wiretapping by officials will get legal limits.

events.event: Police said Jokowi's diploma was already tested by the forensic lab, so no retest is needed.
events.why_it_matters: Ties into the diploma dispute behind the VP resignation drama.

events.event: BNPB reported karhutla easing in most regions, with East Kalimantan and NTT still rising.
events.key_numbers: 283 hotspots · 764 ha being handled · Papua Selatan hotspots -84% · South Sulawesi area handled -47% · Southeast Sulawesi -38%
events.why_it_matters: Tells people in affected provinces whether haze is easing.

events.event: A former customs official was sentenced to 6 years in prison and ordered to pay Rp5.5 billion in a bribery case, per detik's most-read list.
events.why_it_matters: Another customs graft verdict, relevant to import costs and trust in the agency.
events.spreading_evidence: detikNews terpopuler (listed among other notable items)

events.event: Fact-checkers kept flagging fake social-aid registration links, e.g. a PKH 2026 Rp900,000 sign-up link spreading on Facebook, TikTok and WhatsApp that is a phishing scam.
events.key_numbers: Rp900,000 claimed · fact-check dated Jan 2026 (still circulating, not new)
events.why_it_matters: Warns recipients and applicants not to hand personal data to fake bansos links.
events.spreading_evidence: TurnBackHoax listing; old article, current spread unconfirmed
